title: Goldreich–Levin stage records from answers
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive accuracy numerator and denominator $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Given an index $k<n$, a finite family of coordinate subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and one sign-valued answer for each restricted-weight query, form a list with one record for each candidate obtained from the family by either retaining a set or adjoining coordinate $k$. Each record uses the prefix of coordinates $0,\ldots,k$ and stores, as its frequency prefix, that candidate; its rational estimate is the restricted Fourier weight estimate for the candidate's part lying in the prefix.
hypotheses_covered: finite active family of coordinate subsets
